S.FORM: pito ko toki tahiraay to kako i pitilidan anini.
pito ko toki tahiraay to kako i pitilidan anini.
S.PHON: pit[o|u] k[o|u] t[o|u]ki taħiraaj t[o|u] kak[o|u] i pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an anini
S.TRANSL: 我今天七點到學校。
I arrived at school at seven today.

S.FORM: pisatapangan to a minanam, micomoday to ko singsi i laloma' no pitilidan, "katomireng, mita'ong" sa ko kakeridan.
pisatapangan to a minanam, micomoday to ko singsi i laloma' no pitilidan, "katomireng, mita'ong" sa ko kakeridan.
S.PHON: pisatapaŋan t[o|u] a minanam miʦ[o|u]m[o|u][ɬ|ɮ]aj t[o|u] k[o|u] siŋsi i ɾaɾ[o|u]maʡ n[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an kat[o|u]mirəŋ mitaʡ[o|u]ŋ sa k[o|u] kakəri[ɬ|ɮ]an
S.TRANSL: 上課了，老師走進教室，班長說:「起立!敬禮!」
It’s time for class , the teacher walked into the classroom, and the monitor said: “Stand up! Salute!”

S.FORM: sata'angay sa ko ngiha niyam a pasowal to "nga'ay ho singsi."
sata'angay sa ko ngiha niyam a pasowal to "nga'ay ho singsi."
S.PHON: sataʡaŋaj sa k[o|u] ŋiħa nijam a pas[o|u]waɾ t[o|u] ŋaʡaj ħ[o|u] siŋsi
S.TRANSL: 我們大聲的說:「老師好。」
We said loudly, “Hi, teacher.”

S.FORM: to pinanaman i, pasifana'en no singsi kami to sa'osi no 'Amis.
to pinanaman i, pasifana'en no singsi kami to sa'osi no 'Amis.
S.PHON: t[o|u] pinanaman i pasifanaʡən n[o|u] siŋsi kami t[o|u] saʡ[o|u]si n[o|u] ʡamis
S.TRANSL: 上課的時候，老師教我們數字的族語。
In class, the teacher taught us the ’Amis language of numbers.

S.FORM: todongan niyam ko pisa'osi no singsi, radiwan niyam ko sa'osi.
todongan niyam ko pisa'osi no singsi, radiwan niyam ko sa'osi.
S.PHON: t[o|u][ɬ|ɮ][o|u]ŋan nijam k[o|u] pisaʡ[o|u]si n[o|u] siŋsi ra[ɬ|ɮ]iwan nijam k[o|u] saʡ[o|u]si
S.TRANSL: 我們跟著老師唸，我們唱了數字歌。
We followed the teacher to read, we sang the number song.

S.FORM: adihay to ko kafana'an no mako to sowal no 'Amis.
adihay to ko kafana'an no mako to sowal no 'Amis.
S.PHON: a[ɬ|ɮ]iħaj t[o|u] k[o|u] kafanaʡan n[o|u] mak[o|u] t[o|u] s[o|u]waɾ n[o|u] ʡamis
S.TRANSL: 我學會好多族語。
I have learned many ’Amis languages.

S.FORM: mitilid kako to romi'ami'ad, minanam kako to sowal no 'Amis to romi'ami'ad, papitengilen ako ci ina to sowal ako.
mitilid kako to romi'ami'ad, minanam kako to sowal no 'Amis to romi'ami'ad, papitengilen ako ci ina to sowal ako.
S.PHON: mitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ] kak[o|u] t[o|u] r[o|u]miʡamiʡa[ɬ|ɮ] minanam kak[o|u] t[o|u] s[o|u]waɾ n[o|u] ʡamis t[o|u] r[o|u]miʡamiʡa[ɬ|ɮ] papitəŋiɾən ak[o|u] ʦi ina t[o|u] s[o|u]waɾ ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我天天上學，我天天學族語，我要講給媽媽聽。
I go to school every day, I learn the ’Amis language every day, and I want to tell my mother.

S.FORM: ci Kacaw ko ngangan no mako.
ci Kacaw ko ngangan no mako.
S.PHON: ʦi kaʦaw k[o|u] ŋaŋan n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我的名字是kacaw。
My name is kacaw.

S.FORM: ci Asing ko ngangan no wama ako.
ci Asing ko ngangan no wama ako.
S.PHON: ʦi asiŋ k[o|u] ŋaŋan n[o|u] wama ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我爸爸的名字是Asing。
My dad’s name is Asing.

S.FORM: ci Panay ko ngangan no wina ako.
ci Panay ko ngangan no wina ako.
S.PHON: ʦi panaj k[o|u] ŋaŋan n[o|u] wina ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我媽媽的名字是Panay。
My mother’s name is Panay.

S.FORM: mo^tepay to ko mihecaan no mako anini.
mo^tepay to ko mihecaan no mako anini.
S.PHON: m[o|u]ʔtəpaj t[o|u] k[o|u] miħəʦaan n[o|u] mak[o|u] anini
S.TRANSL: 我今年10歲。
I am 10 years old.

S.FORM: cecayay ko kaka ako, ci Kulas ko ngangan ningra, cecayay to ko safaw ko mihecaan ningra.
cecayay ko kaka ako, ci Kulas ko ngangan ningra, cecayay to ko safaw ko mihecaan ningra.
S.PHON: ʦəʦajaj k[o|u] kaka ak[o|u] ʦi kuɾas k[o|u] ŋaŋan niŋra ʦəʦajaj t[o|u] k[o|u] safaw k[o|u] miħəʦaan niŋra
S.TRANSL: 我有一個哥哥，他叫kulas，他今年11歲。
I have a brother, his name is kulas, he is 11 years old.

S.FORM: malacecayay ko pitilidan niyam a mitilid.
malacecayay ko pitilidan niyam a mitilid.
S.PHON: maɾaʦəʦajaj k[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an nijam a mitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]
S.TRANSL: 我們在同一間學校讀書。
We study in the same school.

S.FORM: maolah kako aci kaka a romadiw.
maolah kako aci kaka a romadiw.
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] aʦi kaka a r[o|u]ma[ɬ|ɮ]iw
S.TRANSL: 我和哥哥都喜歡唱歌。
Both my brother and I like to sing.

S.FORM: maolah kako a midangoy, paaliwacan i, malahakelong ko paro no loma' niyam a midangoy.
maolah kako a midangoy, paaliwacan i, malahakelong ko paro no loma' niyam a midangoy.
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] a mi[ɬ|ɮ]aŋ[o|u]j paaɾiwaʦan i maɾaħakəɾ[o|u]ŋ k[o|u] par[o|u] n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ nijam a mi[ɬ|ɮ]aŋ[o|u]j
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡游泳，放假的時候，我們全家會一起去游泳。
I like swimming. During the holidays, our whole family go swimming together.

S.FORM: maolah kako a misawidang to fa^lohay a widang, manga'ay kami a malacafay romadiw ato midangoy.
maolah kako a misawidang to fa^lohay a widang, manga'ay kami a malacafay romadiw ato midangoy.
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] a misawi[ɬ|ɮ]aŋ t[o|u] faʔɾ[o|u]ħaj a wi[ɬ|ɮ]aŋ maŋaʡaj kami a maɾaʦafaj r[o|u]ma[ɬ|ɮ]iw at[o|u] mi[ɬ|ɮ]aŋ[o|u]j
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡認識新朋友，我們可以一起唱歌和游泳。
I love meeting new people, we can sing and swim together.

S.FORM: o wawa no 'Amis kako.
o wawa no 'Amis kako.
S.PHON: [o|u] wawa n[o|u] ʡamis kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我是阿美族的小孩。
I am an ’Amis child.

S.FORM: i Posongay ko loma' niyam.
i Posongay ko loma' niyam.
S.PHON: i p[o|u]s[o|u]ŋaj k[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ nijam
S.TRANSL: 我們家住在台東。
Our family lives in Posongay.

S.FORM: lalima ko paro no loma' niyam.
lalima ko paro no loma' niyam.
S.PHON: ɾaɾima k[o|u] par[o|u] n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ nijam
S.TRANSL: 我們家共有五個人。
There are five people in our family.

S.FORM: tatolo kami a malakaka.
tatolo kami a malakaka.
S.PHON: tat[o|u]ɾ[o|u] kami a maɾakaka
S.TRANSL: 我們家有三個兄弟姊妹。
There are three brothers and sisters in our family.

S.FORM: malacafay kako to wama, wina, kaka to fa'inayan ato kaka to fafahiyan a ma'orip.
malacafay kako to wama, wina, kaka to fa'inayan ato kaka to fafahiyan a ma'orip.
S.PHON: maɾaʦafaj kak[o|u] t[o|u] wama wina kaka t[o|u] faʡinajan at[o|u] kaka t[o|u] fafaħijan a maʡ[o|u]rip
S.TRANSL: 我跟爸爸、媽媽、哥哥和姊姊住在一起。
I live with my father, mother, brother and sister.

S.FORM: akawangay ko wama ako, o malatayxinay ko wama ako.
akawangay ko wama ako, o malatayxinay ko wama ako.
S.PHON: akawaŋaj k[o|u] wama ak[o|u] [o|u] maɾatajxinaj k[o|u] wama ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我的爸爸很高，我的爸爸是警察。
My father is tall and he is a policeman.

S.FORM: mangiliway ko wina ako, o malaisingay ko wina ako.
mangiliway ko wina ako, o malaisingay ko wina ako.
S.PHON: maŋiɾiwaj k[o|u] wina ak[o|u] [o|u] maɾaisiŋaj k[o|u] wina ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我的媽媽很瘦，我的媽媽是醫生。
My mother is thin and my mom is a doctor.

S.FORM: sano'Amisan no wama kami a caciyaw i loma'.
sano'Amisan no wama kami a caciyaw i loma'.
S.PHON: san[o|u]ʡamisan n[o|u] wama kami a ʦaʦijaw i ɾ[o|u]maʡ
S.TRANSL: 爸爸在家會和我們說族語。
My father speaks the ’Amis language with us at home.

S.FORM: pa'aliwacan to kaciherangan i, minokay kami a talaniyaro'.
pa'aliwacan to kaciherangan i, minokay kami a talaniyaro'.
S.PHON: paʡaɾiwaʦan t[o|u] kaʦiħəraŋan i min[o|u]kaj kami a taɾanijar[o|u]ʡ
S.TRANSL: 我們暑假都會回部落。
We will all go back to the tribe during the summer vacation.

S.FORM: malacafay kako to kaka to fa'inayan fafahiyan a mitakora'.
malacafay kako to kaka to fa'inayan fafahiyan a mitakora'.
S.PHON: maɾaʦafaj kak[o|u] t[o|u] kaka t[o|u] faʡinajan fafaħijan a mitak[o|u]raʡ
S.TRANSL: 我和兄姊會一起抓青蛙。
My brothers and sisters and I will catch frogs together.

S.FORM: maolah kako to paro no loma' niyam.
maolah kako to paro no loma' niyam.
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] t[o|u] par[o|u] n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ nijam
S.TRANSL: 我很喜歡我們家的人。
I like our family very much.

S.FORM: masadakay kako aci ina a misalama anini.
masadakay kako aci ina a misalama anini.
S.PHON: masa[ɬ|ɮ]akaj kak[o|u] aʦi ina a misaɾama anini
S.TRANSL: 今天我和媽媽出去玩。
I went out with my mother today.

S.FORM: sa langdaw sa ko kakarayan to romo'ad, cowa kafa^det cowa kasi^naw, saemelay ko falifali.
sa langdaw sa ko kakarayan to romo'ad, cowa kafa^det cowa kasi^naw, saemelay ko falifali.
S.PHON: sa ɾaŋ[ɬ|ɮ]aw sa k[o|u] kakarajan t[o|u] r[o|u]m[o|u]ʡa[ɬ|ɮ] ʦ[o|u]wa kafaʔ[ɬ|ɮ]ət ʦ[o|u]wa kasiʔnaw saəməɾaj k[o|u] faɾifaɾi
S.TRANSL: 白天的天空很藍，天氣不冷也不熱，風很涼爽。
The sky is blue during the day, the weather is neither cold nor hot, and the wind is cool.

S.FORM: i rengorengosan kami a komaen to ^pang, mapaedil no cidal ko tatirengan, tada dihekoay.
i rengorengosan kami a komaen to ^pang, mapaedil no cidal ko tatirengan, tada dihekoay.
S.PHON: i rəŋ[o|u]rəŋ[o|u]san kami a k[o|u]maən t[o|u] ʔpaŋ mapaə[ɬ|ɮ]iɾ n[o|u] ʦi[ɬ|ɮ]aɾ k[o|u] tatirəŋan ta[ɬ|ɮ]a [ɬ|ɮ]iħək[o|u]aj
S.TRANSL: 我們在草地上吃著麵包，陽光灑在身上，非常溫暖。
We ate bread on the grass, the sun was shining on us, and it was very warm.

S.FORM: herek no lahok, masakahengangay to ko kakarayan.
herek no lahok, masakahengangay to ko kakarayan.
S.PHON: ħərək n[o|u] ɾaħ[o|u]k masakaħəŋaŋaj t[o|u] k[o|u] kakarajan
S.TRANSL: 下午，天空變紅了。
In the afternoon, the sky turned red.

S.FORM: licay han ako ci ina, mana kahengang ko kakarayan.
licay han ako ci ina, mana kahengang ko kakarayan.
S.PHON: ɾiʦaj ħan ak[o|u] ʦi ina mana kaħəŋaŋ k[o|u] kakarajan
S.TRANSL: 我問媽媽，為甚麼天空是紅色的。
I asked my mother why the sky is red.

S.FORM: sowal sa ci ina, wa aira ko faliyos a tayni alatek.
sowal sa ci ina, wa aira ko faliyos a tayni alatek.
S.PHON: s[o|u]waɾ sa ʦi ina wa aira k[o|u] faɾij[o|u]s a tajni aɾatək
S.TRANSL: 媽媽說，可能是颱風要來了。
Mom said, maybe the typhoon is coming.

S.FORM: awaay ko to'em/kadit i kakarayan, masadakay to ko fo'is.
awaay ko to'em/kadit i kakarayan, masadakay to ko fo'is.
S.PHON: awaaj k[o|u] t[o|u]ʡəmka[ɬ|ɮ]it i kakarajan masa[ɬ|ɮ]akaj t[o|u] k[o|u] f[o|u]ʡis
S.TRANSL: 晚上天上沒有雲，星星出來了。
There were no clouds in the sky at night, and the stars came out.

S.FORM: wa maminokay to kami.
wa maminokay to kami.
S.PHON: wa mamin[o|u]kaj t[o|u] kami
S.TRANSL: 我們也要回家了。
We were going home too.

S.FORM: i fatad no pinokayan a lalan, ira ko pinanay no faloco' ako to fo'is.
i fatad no pinokayan a lalan, ira ko pinanay no faloco' ako to fo'is.
S.PHON: i fata[ɬ|ɮ] n[o|u] pin[o|u]kajan a ɾaɾan ira k[o|u] pinanaj n[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ ak[o|u] t[o|u] f[o|u]ʡis
S.TRANSL: 在回家的路上，我跟星星許願。
On the way home, I made a wish with the stars,

S.FORM: nanay aka ho katayni koni a faliyos, sakasadakan nanay ho kako a misalama.
nanay aka ho katayni koni a faliyos, sakasadakan nanay ho kako a misalama.
S.PHON: nanaj aka ħ[o|u] katajni k[o|u]ni a faɾij[o|u]s sakasa[ɬ|ɮ]akan nanaj ħ[o|u] kak[o|u] a misaɾama
S.TRANSL: 希望颱風不要來，我還想再出去玩。
I hope the typhoon doesn't come, I still want to go out to play again.

S.FORM: i tatihiay no loma' ako ko pitilidan, saka rakat sanay kako a talapitilidan, rakat sanay kako a minokay to romi'ami'ad.
i tatihiay no loma' ako ko pitilidan, saka rakat sanay kako a talapitilidan, rakat sanay kako a minokay to romi'ami'ad.
S.PHON: i tatiħiaj n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ ak[o|u] k[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an saka rakat sanaj kak[o|u] a taɾapitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an rakat sanaj kak[o|u] a min[o|u]kaj t[o|u] r[o|u]miʡamiʡa[ɬ|ɮ]
S.TRANSL: 我的學校在我們家旁邊，我天天走路去學校，也走路回家。
My school is next to our house, I walk to school every day, and I also walk home.

S.FORM: cowa katata'ang ko pitilidan niyam, cowa ka'aloman ko mitiliday, sahto o kananaman to.
cowa katata'ang ko pitilidan niyam, cowa ka'aloman ko mitiliday, sahto o kananaman to.
S.PHON: ʦ[o|u]wa katataʡaŋ k[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an nijam ʦ[o|u]wa kaʡaɾ[o|u]man k[o|u] mitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]aj saħt[o|u] [o|u] kananaman t[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我們學校不大，沒有很多學生，大家互相認識。
Our school is not big, there are not many students, everyone knows each other.

S.FORM: cowa kata'angay ko pitilidan niyam, cowa ka'aloman ko mitiliday, sahto o kananaman to.
cowa kata'angay ko pitilidan niyam, cowa ka'aloman ko mitiliday, sahto o kananaman to.
S.PHON: ʦ[o|u]wa kataʡaŋaj k[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an nijam ʦ[o|u]wa kaʡaɾ[o|u]man k[o|u] mitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]aj saħt[o|u] [o|u] kananaman t[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我們學校不大，沒有很多學生，大家互相認識。
All the children will gather in the playground, play ball and chat together.

S.FORM: mapolong ko kaemangay a masa'opo i kasa'opoan a malacecay ko pisalama kalalicay.
mapolong ko kaemangay a masa'opo i kasa'opoan a malacecay ko pisalama kalalicay.
S.PHON: map[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ŋ k[o|u] kaəmaŋaj a masaʡ[o|u]p[o|u] i kasaʡ[o|u]p[o|u]an a maɾaʦəʦaj k[o|u] pisaɾama kaɾaɾiʦaj
S.TRANSL: 所有小朋友會聚在操場，一起玩球、一起聊天。
The teachers also play with us, the school is one big family.

S.FORM: mikihatiyaay ko singsi i tamiyanan a misalama, o ta'angyay to a laloma'an ko pitilidan.
mikihatiyaay ko singsi i tamiyanan a misalama, o ta'angyay to a laloma'an ko pitilidan.
S.PHON: mikiħatijaaj k[o|u] siŋsi i tamijanan a misaɾama [o|u] taʡaŋjaj t[o|u] a ɾaɾ[o|u]maʡan k[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an
S.TRANSL: 老師們也會和我們一起玩，學校是個大家庭。
We have to clean every day, and everyone has to clean the classroom.

S.FORM: miasikay to kami to romi'ami'ad, songila'en ita a miasik ko pitilidan.
miasikay to kami to romi'ami'ad, songila'en ita a miasik ko pitilidan.
S.PHON: miasikaj t[o|u] kami t[o|u] r[o|u]miʡamiʡa[ɬ|ɮ] s[o|u]ŋiɾaʡən ita a miasik k[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an
S.TRANSL: 我們每天都要打掃，大家要把教室打掃乾淨。
Some people clean the windows, some sweep the floor.

S.FORM: misifin ko roma to sasingaran, miasik ko roma to paenan.
misifin ko roma to sasingaran, miasik ko roma to paenan.
S.PHON: misifin k[o|u] r[o|u]ma t[o|u] sasiŋaran miasik k[o|u] r[o|u]ma t[o|u] paənan
S.TRANSL: 有些人去擦窗戶，有些人去掃地。
We will also clean every corner of the school. Everyone works together, and the school is very clean every day.

S.FORM: mafana' aca kami a miasik to tadimocomocok no pitilidan, mala'esal kita to tatayalen nga' , makapah ko pitilidan to romi'ami'ad.
mafana' aca kami a miasik to tadimocomocok no pitilidan, mala'esal kita to tatayalen nga' , makapah ko pitilidan to romi'ami'ad.
S.PHON: mafanaʡ aʦa kami a miasik t[o|u] ta[ɬ|ɮ]im[o|u]ʦ[o|u]m[o|u]ʦ[o|u]k n[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an maɾaʡəsaɾ kita t[o|u] tatajaɾən ŋaʡ makapaħ k[o|u] pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an t[o|u] r[o|u]miʡamiʡa[ɬ|ɮ]
S.TRANSL: 我們還會打掃學校的各個角落，大家分工合作，學校每天都很乾淨。
